claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Phenytoin is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen; at 2.5 uM it lacks a cytotoxic mechanism, and any weak antiproliferative signal would reflect sodium-channel-blocking/antiepileptic class effects rather than a potent killing mechanism.
